'''Xuvva Hunter's Sport Rifle''' was a make of [[sporting blaster rifle]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Imperial Agent|agent]] codenamed [[Cipher Nine]] acquired one while in the [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. Selling for 25 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], parts of the [[Color/Legends|black]]-colored [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] could be modified, including its [[Crystal/Legends|color crystal]]. The weapons were designed for use [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Xuvva]],<ref name="TORS" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of winged predators native to Nal Hutta.<ref name="TORX">{{TORcite|type=codex|Xuvva}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Xuvva Hunter's Sport [[Rifle/Legends|Rifle]] first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The rifle is rewarded to players of the Imperial Agent class, the only class who can use it, after they complete the class mission "Soiree" on Hutta. It is not clear where the player acquires the rifle during the mission.
